# Browser tools and fonts

These browser libraries are bundled so document processing and face matching can run without a third-party asset service.

| Asset | Version | Source |
|---|---|---|
| PDF.js reader, fonts, and CMaps | 4.10.38 | https://www.npmjs.com/package/pdfjs-dist/v/4.10.38 |
| pdf-lib | 1.17.1 | https://www.npmjs.com/package/pdf-lib/v/1.17.1 |
| @pdf-lib/fontkit | 1.1.1 | https://www.npmjs.com/package/@pdf-lib/fontkit/v/1.1.1 |
| Mammoth | 1.11.0 | https://www.npmjs.com/package/mammoth/v/1.11.0 |
| docx | 9.15.3 | https://www.npmjs.com/package/docx/v/9.15.3 |
| @vladmandic/face-api and face model weights | 1.7.15 | https://www.npmjs.com/package/@vladmandic/face-api/v/1.7.15 |
| DejaVu Sans | 2.37 | https://dejavu-fonts.github.io/ |

The packages’ notices are in `licenses/`. PDF.js font and CMap notices are in their respective folders. The Face API browser bundle incorporates TensorFlow.js.
